$comment: Findings the release gate does not block on, each with a reason and a date it stops applying.
An entry belongs here only when the fix cannot be obtained from this repository: code vendored
inside the base image's own binaries, where the image vendor is the only party who can ship it.
A package this repository installs is never allowlisted; it is bumped.
Every entry prints on every run, an expired entry fails the build, and an entry that matches
nothing prints as stale. scripts/check-image-scan.mjs enforces all three.

entries.reason: OpenSSL statically linked inside the Node binary in node:22-slim. Inspector reports the fix as OpenSSL 4.0.2; no Node 22 image ships it, so nothing in this repository can obtain it. Clears when the Node image rebases onto a fixed OpenSSL, or when the runtime moves to a Node major that bundles 4.x.
